overview:
David Kustoff seeks another term in a west Tennessee district that leans Republican by about ten points. He enters the general election with roughly $3 million on hand after raising more than $2.2 million, while Democratic nominee Heidi Kuhn has raised about $40,000 and reports under $15,000 in cash. Several independent candidates are also on the ballot, none with meaningful funding.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district lean, incumbency, and money. Prediction markets give Kustoff about a 95 percent chance of winning. The combination of a favorable partisan lean, a well-funded incumbent, and a minimally funded challenger points to a comfortable Republican win, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of direct polling in the district.
